record.paper_title: Ordered Banach algebras and multi-norms: some open problems
record.original_question: Let A be a Banach algebra equipped with a multi-norm (||·||_n) based on the Banach space A such that ||(a_1 b_1, ..., a_n b_n)||_n <= ||(a_1, ..., a_n)||_n ||(b_1, ..., b_n)||_n for all n and all a_i,b_i in A; in other words, let (A,||·||_n) be a multi-Banach algebra. Is there a useful general theory of such multi-Banach algebras?

evidence.quote: Is there any useful general theory of multi-Banach algebras?

artifact.status_search_result: The question is a programmatic open problem asking for the development of a general theory of multi-Banach algebras. The foundational framework of multi-norms was established by Dales and Polyakov (2012), and subsequent work has explored multi-norms, p-multi-norms, and connections with Banach lattices, but no comprehensive structural theory of multi-Banach algebras appears to have been developed. The status remains open as a research program.

status_evidence.title: Multi-norms and multi-Banach algebras (Dales)
status_evidence.snippet: Lecture notes by Dales on multi-norms and multi-Banach algebras introducing the framework and listing open directions.
status_evidence.claim: The general theory of multi-Banach algebras is presented as an emerging area without a comprehensive structure theory.

status_evidence.title: Multi-norms and Banach lattices
status_evidence.snippet: Survey developing multi-norms via Banach lattices; focuses on multi-norms rather than a developed multi-Banach algebra theory.
status_evidence.claim: Research has focused on multi-norms, with the general theory of multi-Banach algebras still undeveloped.
